g.text: AoiRank4Convo7 begins.
Check boolean AoiVoidTongue
so, i think i have it!
true
Check boolean AoiPianoLesson
false
<RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>
What do you have?
ahem ahem! are u ready for your piano lesson?
true
may i introduce u to a friend? 'Mr Piano' is his name.
false
+5 Chemistry
a way to play piano, play any music really, without thinking about 'Void Tongue'
Sign me up.
Not right now. [End.]
<RETRO_EMOJI_JOY>
or mayyyybe i'm getting ahead of myself. well, what is Void Tongue?
let us begin first with: why music? why piano?
Chat ends.
I have a way to play piano, play any music really, without thinking about 'Void Tongue'
That's not easy to answer. Sounds, words, utterances from the Void. A curse, more like it. A communication of something to whatever ears can hear it.
It's something I never want to hear again.
It's the language of what is causing all this, I think. How it speaks.
it's easier to start a piano lesson this way because umm, i can't find a piano. so let's stick to theory.
wut <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
like a bad song, then?
is it like, a sing-songy language or?
Ok, let's stick to theory.
How hard did you look?
Where would we find a piano?
well now i really need to get you some music. think about it. drown out this 'Void Tongue' with a song of your own, right?
Let's leave it at that. [End.]
In a way, I guess.
I don't really know how to describe it. But it's powerful.
It's nothing you want to hear. It's part of why all this is happening.
yay! so, to really catch you up, music has been really important here for like, ever. guys and girls would sit at a piano instead of a tv and just create.
well, kinda hard? i wasn't sure about going into empty apartments out there...
hmm, they're big and hard to hide... I doubt that Viktor and Scaldra play.
Chat ends.
It's powerful enough to change life. There's these animals I know. Friends, I'd say. The Cavia. They touched the Void and learned to *speak* like magic.
It is the cause of so much pain.
playing... writing... really a song is a bit like communicating through music. you don't even need lyrics!
ugh. Scaldra. they probably destroyed them. why would they let something hopeful like an instrument survive this place?
And when they speak now, it started so hopeless. So wrong. The Void Tongue just let these creatures feel one thing at first: hopeless.
I can't stand to hear it.
But even still, I feel like I know how to speak it.
but imagine it - creating something for this world of ours that can make people cry? dance? sing? it's magic to me.
but wait, let me ask u then, if there is music in the future, maybe there's hope. so...
don't call me stupid but have u tried playing music for them? your friends? maybe it would help even for 1 second?
And that scares me. It's like a song I want to unhear. Like a magic curse that should be GONE.
Magic? I don't think so. I do like a good song, though.
Music has been a part of what I've been through. Memories through songs, I get it.
Please. tell me about a song then.
don't you think music could break through and be hope? for just, well, everyone? everything? if Void Tongue is 'magic', than so is music.
it's ok, it's ok. i get it. music can feel hopeless too.
maybe u'll believe me one day.
+10 Chemistry
Music can define memories. "Smiles from Juran" is a song I heard in the mind, the memories, of someone who lost everything.
Music can be hopeful. There's something about knowing "We All Lift Together", right?
Music can be evil, Aoi. These people that I tried to save, they were cursed by song. "For Narmer", they sang out.
Play a song for me, won't you then?
You've listened to too many songs, maybe.
Chat ends.
Picture it. Everything is taken from you - family, life, your own sense of self.
Finding joy through song, meaning, shared experience.
You don't know what it's like to see that.
+10 Chemistry
well, just ur opinion. thanks for hearing me out.
And one song, just one song, is the very groundwork for you to find yourself.
It's fun. It's hopeful. A lot of us don't get to choose our life circumstances.
Sol I'm so sorry, please, tell me.
always!!!!
Chat ends.
I like to think if I ever lost myself, music would be a way for me to find my way.
But we can still choose to sing together, about it all. About nothing. Just sing.
Telling you here on this almost feels wrong, I wish I could sing it to you, but if I can say anything it's that evil...
Update boolean AoiPlaySong
what ur saying...
Music is powerful.
Evil will try and ruin the good. I've seen it happen to music. No one should ever sing praise to the damned.
Chat ends.
it feels like, well, how i feel. that feels like a law of the universe.
this is embarassing but, i have a similar story. not nearly as heavy but still.. maybe you'll understand.
when i was a kid, like 'kid Aoi', i wanted to be friends with everyone.
Sounds like the Aoi I know.
Really? Aoi being Friendly?
+10 Chemistry
i'll ignore that!
<RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>
but there was this one kid, who the bullies would ALWAYS pick on. Always.
and they would sing mean songs about the kid. awful, mean songs.
and when i saw music being used to cause pain, it broke something in me as a kid. i didn't understand.
i still don't understand. but i knew then that i could fight back without raising a fist, even if it meant embarrassing myself.
So what did you do?
Did you embarrass yourself?
i sang louder than the bullies. it was a stupid song, i don't even remember how it went.
but it worked.
and when they tried to bully me, they would throw CD's at me, but guess what?
The CDs were made of metal?
You crushed them?
ha! nope. i got free music! score for Aoi!
i guess wut i'm hoping you know and everyone here, is that i'd sing louder for all of you.
always.
Chat ends.
